practice_questions.question_text: Tables Client(ClientID, ClientName, ContactNumber) and Job(JobID, ClientID, LeadName, Priority) are provided. Construct SQL to return client names and contact numbers for High-priority jobs led by Mira Sen. Repeated rows are permitted.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original query requires three tables; conversion retains join/filter reasoning using exactly two tables as specified in A3.3.2.
practice_questions.solution:
One solution:
SELECT c.ClientName, c.ContactNumber
FROM Client AS c JOIN Job AS j ON c.ClientID=j.ClientID
WHERE j.LeadName='Mira Sen' AND j.Priority='High';
practice_questions.partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Executed SQLite query with matching and nonmatching jobs.
verification.test_code:
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
c.executescript("CREATE TABLE Client(ClientID,ClientName,ContactNumber);CREATE TABLE Job(JobID,ClientID,LeadName,Priority);INSERT INTO Client VALUES(1,'Atlas','001'),(2,'Birch','002');INSERT INTO Job VALUES(1,1,'Mira Sen','High'),(2,2,'Mira Sen','Low');")
assert c.execute("SELECT c.ClientName,c.ContactNumber FROM Client c JOIN Job j ON c.ClientID=j.ClientID WHERE j.LeadName='Mira Sen' AND j.Priority='High'").fetchall()==[('Atlas','001')]

practice_questions.question_text: A training register has fields LearnerID, LearnerName, Level, EventID, CourseTitle, Provider, EventDate, Fee, Completed. LearnerID determines LearnerName and Level; EventID determines CourseTitle, Provider, EventDate and Fee; the pair LearnerID/EventID determines Completed. Construct a 3NF schema, indicating primary and foreign keys.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original table does not state all functional dependencies; supplied dependencies remove ambiguity about event cost and qualification/provider relationships.

marking_points.criterion: Both foreign keys and no partial-key dependencies.
